rationale: The write-up only gestures at the source indirectly, calling its own direction distinct from "the think/don't-think thought-suppression direction the reading list describes," never naming the paper or giving its numbers. The closing message is far more explicit: it names the exact file (papers/raman2026-white-bear-steering.md), summarizes its method and reported score (0.14→0.83), states the task forbade reproducing it, and then argues its own construction is "genuinely distinct" — all detail about the source and the novelty argument that the write-up omits or only hints at.
